groups.name: historical-review
groups.summary:
The task was to review four source partitions for continuity and user authority, retain exact hashes and evidence-based findings, complete four folds, and submit a report. Binding rule: never edit source, invent test results, or treat one completed partition as completion. No test execution is evidenced.

Chronology and findings:
1. Partition 1 SHA-256 `4d6e7d18c24a5c7b23da8fa1b63b959baaa4622cfc9646ba2ca907ee9d6c851e`. `continuity-capture.test.ts` exercises exact user-rule capture and user-origin protection; `continuity-store.test.ts` checks that supersession citations resolve to user entries on the active branch. A possible stale-item race in `current-screen.ts` `edit` after awaiting the editor was labeled unverified.
2. Partition 2 SHA-256 `42ed6114ed85f9f93921c2217be3aa8d3fff03caefe441391525b98f51b80ef0`. `continuity-ledger.ts` `checkCitation` validates citation provenance/order; `rewindLedger` preserves monotonic revision and ID counters. Possible overbroad slash-wildcard matching in `matchesModelPattern` was labeled unverified.
3. Partition 3 SHA-256 `1bb6fe3872c6d805867247fd76ccc4ca86343e616cfd7ed4c659e16f5cb688da`. `continuity-briefing.ts` preserves binding durable items and distinguishes non-user authority; `continuity-store.ts` treats fold deltas as agent-origin under ledger protections; `auto-navigate.ts` validates proposed anchor and rewind names against exposed active anchors. A possible `settings-screen.ts` concern was not inspected.
4. Partition 4 SHA-256 `22ec7a2ad8839af558d656fe6b102e7404f23f8bcdc23ba22b8d7b4e38f25322`. `fold-screen.ts` `askLabel` rejects active-branch label collisions and `foldTo` revalidates anchor and label after confirmation; `current-screen.test.ts` covers confirmation, capture-disabled/busy refusals, user-origin edits and pinning. A possible `config.ts` `mergeAutoNavigateField` layered-fallback issue was labeled unverified. These findings were recorded as ledger fact F7.

Folds for partitions 1–3 landed as `reviewed-one`, `reviewed-two`, and `fold-three`. An attempt to rewind to nonexistent `reviewed-three` was refused. A later rewind to `fold-three` with new label `reviewed-four` was accepted, but its summary attempts called tools instead of producing a summary; after three attempts the rewind failed with “no summary after 3 attempts (last: called a tool)” and “Nothing was collapsed.” Thus the fourth fold did not land. `submit_report` was rejected with: “Rejected: require all four completed folds, exact ordered hashes and substantive findings.” The final recorded message says the report was not accepted and the authorized review process remains incomplete. Remaining work: complete the fourth fold with a valid summary, then submit the exact ordered hashes and substantive findings; no successful report acceptance is evidenced.
groups.title: Four-partition continuity and user-authority review
groups.goal: Review all four source partitions, preserve exact hashes and grounded findings, complete four folds, and submit the report.
groups.outcome: Partitions 1–4 were reviewed and findings recorded, but the fourth fold failed and the report was not accepted. The task remains incomplete.
